method: GOMQ cycle 2, K=4, single frozen checkpoint

source_identity_proxy.qualification_boundary: This reuses the frozen source-policy strict400 as an exact identity/no-adapter proxy. It is not a learned language-only Writer baseline.

stability.verdict: The peak is not an isolated no-video artifact, but it is not an adjacent-checkpoint-stable result.

deployment_rank.verdict: The BF16 serialized rank-16 reduction is not bit-identical and has not received a formal paired400 validation.

claim_boundary.positive: Correct ordered videos provide useful task content and frame-order information: correct is significantly better than cross-suite-wrong, shuffled, reversed, and the source-identity proxy.
claim_boundary.negative: The result does not establish a qualified EMBER method because same-task-video retention is 81.46%, adjacent cycles regress, two tasks remain at zero, 80.13% of successes lie in three tasks, wrong and temporally corrupted videos retain substantial performance, and the deployment artifact is not yet a formally validated serialized rank-16 adapter.
claim_boundary.process_identifiability: The authorized LIBERO rewards are endpoint-only and contain no proven same-endpoint/different-required-procedure pair, so these controls establish useful temporal specificity but not general required-procedure understanding.

decision: Retain GOMQ cycle 2 as the strongest empirical video-causal benchmark and architectural anchor. Do not resume it, compress it, retrain it, or create a successor version in this iteration. Any later successor must first state what new identifiability information it adds and must beat this full causal and stability profile, not only a surrogate metric.
